csharp_prefer_braces #

Whether braces are required. IDE0011 documents true, false and when_multiline. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified wrong subsystem — a Roslyn analyser's. Flat at true:none, false:none, when_multiline:none, true:warning and false:warning, under both CSReformatCode and the cleanup profile, on a fixture carrying braced and unbraced if, while and foreach. ⚠ The negative control is the point: ReSharper's own resharper_braces_for_ifelse is equally flat at required, not_required and required_for_multiline under both profiles, so neither oracle profile performs brace insertion at all and no oracle fixture can pin this key. It is IDE0011, a Roslyn analyser.

resharper_simple_embedded_statement_style #

Whether a simple embedded statement is put on one line. ⚠ Probed rather than reasoned about: eleven fixtures under this repository's own .editorconfig, one cleanupcode invocation per configuration, each fixture first shown to move under the key that really governs its construct. Inert at all three values, at 120 and at 60 columns, and with keep_existing_embedded_arrangement = false in the same run — byte-identical to that run without this key. csharp_place_simple_embedded_statement_on_same_line is what joins and splits those statements.
